name: axial_turbine_loss_models
title: Axial-turbine loss models: Aungier, Balje-Binsley, Kacker-Okapuu (function library)
summary: Total-pressure loss coefficients of an axial-turbine blade row: the complete Aungier system (profile, secondary-flow, tip-clearance, trailing-edge, supersonic-expansion, shock and lashing-wire losses, one FUNCTION each plus the PROCEDURE Aungier_axial_loss), the Balje-Binsley profile loss and the Kacker-Okapuu secondary loss of the sCO2 method of Lee et al. (2012). Coefficients outside 0..1 or with invalid inputs return -1; source defects are documented. The demonstration program re-runs the ORC (R245fa) and sCO2 (R744) examples of LaboThapPy.

authors: Basile Chaudoir (LaboThapPy, ULiege; author of both translated files in the repository history)

origin.notes: LaboThapPy commit f03f7f47 (files above, last commit 2026-08-18). The source cites no reference for the Aungier module (names and comments suggest R. H. Aungier, Turbine Aerodynamics, ASME Press, 2006, not checked); pressure_loss_model.py cites J. Lee, J. I. Lee, Y. Ahn, H. Yoon, Design methodology of supercritical CO2 Brayton cycle turbomachineries (2012). Inventory row LTP-051 (kept todo by C-373); LTP-007 and LTP-066 are duplicates of it (mean-line component and PSO design loops not translated).

verification.summary: LaboThapPy (commit f03f7f47) re-run in a virtual environment (CoolProp 8.0.0) on the same inputs: 52 loss coefficients (ORC and sCO2 cases, Km, lashing wires, Balje-Binsley, Kacker-Okapuu) agree, max rel. deviation 4.1e-13; invalid cases flagged -1. Printed reference values of the ORC example reproduced within 8 % (rotor Yte +20 %); no publication checked.
verification.reference: LaboThapPy commit f03f7f47 re-run in a throw-away virtual environment under work/: aungier_loss_model (unmodified and with the trailing-edge sine in degrees), balje_binsley and kacker_okaapu on the ORC and Test cases of the source, a Mach-correction case, lashing wires and 6 + 6 argument sets
verification.notes: 52 values compared (Yp, Ys, Ycl, Yte, Yex, Ysh, Ylw, Y_tot, Km, Balje-Binsley, Kacker-Okapuu), max relative deviation 4.08e-13; Yte and Y_tot of the ORC cases are compared with the original with the unit fix of defect 1 (unmodified original: Y_tot 0.19533 / 0.25322 against 0.19542 / 0.25409). Every -1 flag has a Python value outside 0..1 or an input the guards reject. Printed reference values of the ORC example (origin not stated): components within +8.4 % / -5.3 %, rotor Yte +20 %, totals +2.3 % / +0.4 %. CoolSolve CoolProp 8.1.0dev gives another R245fa viscosity (1.2388e-5 vs 1.4115e-5 Pa-s), without effect on the results (roughness-limited Reynolds regime). No publication checked. Re-check 2026-11-02 (card C-484, build 0.4.0@2dc1367): after restoring the powers hidden by CS-BUG-PROC-NEG-POW, the new .sol is byte-for-byte identical to the previous baseline.
